mission_10: This capstone mission challenges you to build a complete normalization pipeline that applies different scaling strategies to different columns based on their characteristics. Real-world datasets rarely benefit from a one-size-fits-all approach. Skewed columns need power transforms, approximately normal columns work well with standardization, and bounded columns are suited for min-max scaling. You will profile the data, select appropriate transformations for each column, and combine the results into a unified normalized dataset. This demonstrates the sophisticated preprocessing decisions required in production ML systems.
